display.purpose: Page titles and dashboard heading only.

label.purpose: Badge text, navigation labels, type indicators.

mono.purpose: Code blocks, terminal output, file paths.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition easing for state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button. Ink background, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #18181b; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: normal; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #27272a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; ring: 3px solid #b0b0b0; ring-opacity: 0.5; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #3f3f46; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent background with border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #fafafa; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #18181b; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; ring: 3px solid #b0b0b0; ring-opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Card Container
components.description: Content container. Flat surface with subtle ring border.
components.html:
React Patterns

Collection of React component patterns and hooks.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #18181b; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; color: #fafafa; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; border: none; box-shadow: none; } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 12px; pointer-events: none; border: 1px solid rgba(250, 250, 250, 0.1); } .ds-card-header { padding-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; margin: 0; } .ds-card-content { color: #a1a1aa; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input. Transparent background, subtle border.
components.css: .ds-input { background: transparent; color: #fafafa; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; width: 100%; min-width: 0; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a1a1aa; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #b0b0b0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(176, 176, 176, 0.5); } .ds-input:disabled { background: rgba(39, 39, 42, 0.5); cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-input[aria-invalid] { border-color: #ef4444; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Compact label. Small radius for tight appearance.
components.css: .ds-badge { background: #18181b; color: #fafafa; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 2px 6px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary action. No background until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #fafafa; border: none; border-radius: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #18181b; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(176, 176, 176, 0.5); }

narrative.overview: DevStash is a tool interface — not a marketing page. The visual system serves the product: fast retrieval, clear organization, zero distraction. Dark-first, type-driven, restrained color. The aesthetic is the same as Linear, Raycast, and VS Code.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, monochrome base with functional color
Geist typeface family: clean, technical, highly legible
Flat surfaces with tonal layering (no shadows)
Item-type colors as the sole chromatic vocabulary

rules.name: The One-Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated colors appear only as item-type identifiers, focus rings, or destructive states. No section, card, or decorative element may use them.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: DevStash uses one font family (Geist) in multiple weights. No font pairing, no third typeface.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Elevation comes from background tone shifts and ring borders only.

dos: Do use dark mode as the default canvas
Do use item-type colors solely for their functional purpose
Do keep surfaces flat with tonal layering and ring borders
Do use Geist for all text
Do use 8px radius as the default corner treatment
donts: Don't add a brand accent color
Don't use neon, glow, or gradient effects
Don't introduce a second font family
Don't use saturated colors on decorative elements
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe
Don't use glassmorphism as a default treatment
